summary: Frontend-only visual/UX upgrade validation. Verified new sidebar wordmark (Portal Support / Artamedia with Bricolage Grotesque font + gradient), collapsed 'PS' badge, greeting ticker above header with correct time-based label, marquee animation (tickerScroll 38s, pauses on hover), and no regression across Dashboard/Customers/Documents (BA + KMZ)/Network/Operations. Light + dark themes both render brand cleanly. 18/18 UI assertions passed.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' briefly during initial mount — pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration. Cosmetic, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: GreetingTicker still imports the Radio icon (used only inside marquee item) — this is intentional per the ticker content ('Portal Support Artamedia · Enterprise NOC dashboard'). Sidebar correctly no longer imports Radio.

GreetingTicker recreates the items array whenever `now` changes (every 30s) — cheap but the marquee will re-render/restart. Consider memoizing on Icon+label+displayName only (drop `now`) so the animation loop stays continuous. Non-blocking.
